info.name: FieldOps Mobile & Agent API Collection (Full Contract & RPC)
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for all FieldOps Mobile APIs, supporting both:
1. Client Contract REST routes (/auth/*, /agent/*)
2. Direct Frappe RPC endpoints (/api/method/fieldops.api.mobile_api.*)

Authentication:
- Run 'POST Login' or 'RPC mobile_login' first. The Bearer access_token will be automatically captured into collection variables.
- All subsequent requests use Bearer {{access_token}} and Host: {{host_header}} headers.

exec: const first = (json?.data && Array.isArray(json.data) && json.data.length) ? json.data[0] : null;

request.description:
Submit a pre-order/sales order for an outlet.

Accepted Outlet fields: `outlet_id`, `outlet`, `customer_id`, `customer`, `customerId`, `outletId`, `customer_name`.
Accepted Campaign fields: `campaign_id`, `campaign`, `campaignId`, `campaign_name` (e.g. 'CAM-00005' or 'Visibility Campaign'). Defaults to agent's assigned active campaign if omitted.
Accepted Items array: `items`, `products`, `order_items`, `cart`.
Accepted Item fields: `product_id`, `productId`, `item_code`, `item`, `product_name`, `itemName`, `qty`, `quantity`, `unit_price`, `unitPrice`, `rate`, `price`, `amount`.

Log an immediate secondary field sale from mobile app.

Accepted Outlet fields: `outlet_id`, `outlet`, `customer_id`, `customer`, `customerId`, `outletId`, `customer_name`.
Accepted Campaign fields: `campaign_id`, `campaign`, `campaignId`, `campaign_name` (e.g. 'CAM-00005' or 'Visibility Campaign'). Defaults to agent's assigned active campaign if omitted.
Accepted Items array: `items`, `products`, `order_items`, `cart` (supports multi-item order array or root-level item fields).
Accepted Item fields: `product_id`, `productId`, `item_code`, `item`, `product_name`, `itemName`, `qty`, `quantity`, `unit_price`, `unitPrice`, `rate`, `price`, `amount`.
Accepted Total: `total_amount`, `totalAmount`, `amount`, `total` (automatically calculated if omitted).
Accepted Payments: `payment_type`, `payment_mode`, `amount_paid` or `payments` array.

RPC endpoint for submitting pre-orders / sales orders.
Supports both single-product payload (root level product_id, qty, unit_price) or multi-product payload (items[] / products[]).
Campaign defaults to agent's assigned active campaign if omitted or unmapped.

RPC endpoint for logging immediate secondary field sales.
Accepts all mobile client aliases for outlet (outlet_id, customer_id, customer, etc.), campaign (campaign_id, campaign_name, or omitted), and items (items, products, cart). Automatically resolves item names, computes total amount, and records payment.
Retrieve logged sales for the authenticated agent.

Create a new outlet / customer from mobile app.

Bidirectional Sync: Automatically creates both the mobile Outlet document and ERPNext Customer Outlets table, making it immediately visible in web flow center, customer outlets, beat planning, and secondary sales.

Accepted Outlet Name fields: `name`, `outlet_name`, `customer_name`.
Accepted Contact Person: `contact_person`, `owner_name`, `ownerName`, `owner`.
Accepted Phone: `phone`, `phone_number`, `phoneNumber`, `owner_phone`, `ownerPhone`, `mobile_no`.
Accepted Email: `email`, `email_address`, `owner_email`.
Accepted Address: `address`, `location`, `residential_address`.
Accepted Coordinates: `latitude` & `longitude`, or `coordinates` object/array, or `coordinates[lat]` & `coordinates[lng]`.
Accepted Classification: `outlet_type` (Retail, Wholesale, Distributor, Other), `category`, `zone`, `area`.
Supports multipart form-data for uploading store images via `images[]`, `images`, `image`, or `photo`.

  "name": "Central Mart Express",
  "owner_name": "Kelechi Onoja",

request.description: Fetch attendance summary stats (present_days, absent_days, late_days, on_time_days, streak_days, attendance_percentage, today_status). Present days increment by 1 for each distinct calendar day the agent clocks in at least once.
RPC method for attendance statistics. Guarantees 1 clock-in per calendar day = 1 present_day counted, regardless of clock-out or multiple clock-ins.
